title: Flight plan timeline, elapsed time 4:30–6:00: maneuver update, closing ΔV ~13 ft/sec
description: Vertical elapsed-time axis from 4:30 to 6:00 listing "MANEUVER UPDATE", "ALIGN PLATFORM", "CLOSING ΔV ~ 13 FT/SEC", "D/T TAPE PLAYBACK" and "MONITOR BOOSTER ELEV". Boxed tracking-station codes (TEX, GYM, CNV, ANT, ASC, TAN, CRO, CSQ, HAW) and a hatched "NIGHT" bar appear at right, with a small handwritten marginal note beside the start of the night period.
